# /data modify: every target kind x operation x source kind, one case that normally succeeds and one that fails.
# Flat world, creative; Bot = op. Targets: storage t:w, the armor stand tagged c, the chest at 0 -60 0.

gamerule random_tick_speed 0
gamerule spawn_mobs false

# ---- setup ----
setblock 0 -60 0 minecraft:chest{Items:[{Slot:0b,id:"minecraft:stone",count:3},{Slot:1b,id:"minecraft:dirt",count:2}]}
setblock 2 -60 0 minecraft:chest{Items:[{Slot:0b,id:"minecraft:apple",count:5}]}
summon minecraft:armor_stand 4 -60 4 {NoGravity:1b,Tags:["a"],DisabledSlots:7,Pose:{Head:[10f,20f,30f]}}

data merge storage t:w {l:[1,2,3],v:0,c:{a:1}}
data merge storage t:s {i:4,s:"str",c:{id:"minecraft:apple",count:1,Slot:3b}}
